units.source_text: 没过多久，我们拐进了一条狭窄的胡同里，我被抬着进入一座房子里。

en.t: Before long, we turned into a narrow alley, and I was carried into a house.

units.source_text: 后面我才了解到，这个房子就是戴夹鼻眼镜的河童——被大家称为查喀的医生的家。

en.t: Only later did I learn that this was the home of the kappa in pince-nez, the doctor everyone called Chaka.

units.source_text: 我被查喀医生安排在一张整洁舒适的床上躺着，他还让我喝了一杯透明的药水。

en.t: Doctor Chaka had me laid on a clean, comfortable bed, and he also made me drink a glass of clear medicine.

units.source_text: 我躺在床上，听由他们的指挥。

en.t: I lay on the bed and simply did as they directed.

units.source_text: 说真的，我全身上下的关节都在疼，我根本动弹不了。

en.t: To tell the truth, every joint in my body ached, and I could not move at all.
